# `aitbc wallet export`

Export the active wallet to a JSON file at the given destination.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet export [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--destination` | text | — | no | Destination file path (default: wallet_name_export.json) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet export
```
